changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_page_space_gitpath ON page (space_id, git_path) WHERE git_path IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_page_version_no ON page_version (page_id, version_no)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_page_root ON page (space_id) WHERE parent_id IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_conflict_open ON sync_conflict (page_id) WHERE resolved_at IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_draft_user_page ON page_draft (page_id, user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_watch_user_page ON page_watch (page_id, user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_syncroot_path ON sync_root (space_id, repo_path)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_page_tree ON page (space_id, parent_id, position) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_outbox_pending ON sync_outbox (space_id, id) WHERE status = 'PENDING'
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_activity_space_time ON activity_event (space_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_notification_unread ON notification (recipient_id, created_at DESC) WHERE read_at IS NULL
